kind: manually reviewed scenario map, not generated-name summaries

scenarios.title: Complete local journey
scenarios.setup: A previously recorded source A and current local B; or no recorded original
scenarios.actions: Click Review, select, Stage, Confirm, Refresh, create a new backup, restore, create editable copy
scenarios.outcomes: Current B and retained A/explicit absence survive; drafts/raw originals unchanged; no automatic archive or account call

scenarios.title: Stop and repeated clicks
scenarios.setup: Real staging worker held on synthetic PDF
scenarios.actions: Repeat buttons, cancel or close while work is held
scenarios.outcomes: One worker/receipt; close waits for actual drain; no document intent after cancelled staging

scenarios.title: Queued stale delivery
scenarios.setup: Native thread finished with GUI install still queued
scenarios.actions: Replace source PDF or switch outer workspace before processing queued delivery
scenarios.outcomes: No accepted plan or foreign workspace write/read lock

scenarios.title: Actual application launch barriers
scenarios.setup: Real MainWindow and real held staging worker
scenarios.outcomes: No installer, lost draft or abandoned worker; original owner remains bound

scenarios.title: Explicit retry and independent account settings
scenarios.setup: Failure or fake account settings change while local work is held
scenarios.actions: Refresh/review again, or finish the original local request
scenarios.outcomes: One saved result; no route/model selection; changed paper row preserved

scenarios.title: Readable compact review
scenarios.setup: Chinese 440x520 native dialog with full source hash
scenarios.outcomes: No horizontal overflow; unchanged full text and height-for-width; actions reachable

scenarios.title: Exact local setup and ownership
scenarios.setup: Existing complete binding, owned BlobStore, actual native identities
scenarios.actions: Stage, race source/parent/native/schema, update registration inside readiness
scenarios.outcomes: Refuse unknown/foreign/stale data without ownership mint; preserve independent actor changes

scenarios.title: Partial batches and first registration
scenarios.setup: One bootstrap original, then registered multi-paper batch
scenarios.actions: Prepare one first; explicitly refresh/review remaining; cancel/fail after an atomic leaf commit
scenarios.outcomes: Completed papers remain; remaining papers can be retried without duplicates

not_proven: real owner data or real account/service/device acceptance
